Frequently Asked Questions

Is ITU better than IMPERIAL?

Both Information Technology University Punjab and Imperial College of Business Studies, Lahore are HEC-recognized universities. ITU is public (est. 2012) in Lahore, while IMPERIAL is private (est. 1991) in Lahore. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between ITU and IMPERIAL?

ITU's fee is approximately Rs. 1.95–2.25L/sem per semester, while IMPERIAL's is Rs. 350,000–1,350,000 total program fee. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for ITU and IMPERIAL?

ITU: UG (CS/AI): 50% Academic + 50% Test (min 50% test score). Engineering: 50% Academic + 50% ECAT/Test. MS varies — interview component added.. IMPERIAL: Min 45% in Intermediate (HSSC). A-Level students need IBCC Equivalence. Result-awaiting students may apply provisionally. Overseas applicants require HEC NOC..
